discoveredTool.name: validate_coding_plan
discoveredTool.description: Validate a coding task DAG, estimates, dependencies, parallel candidates, critical path, and execution priority.

arguments.goal: Build and release a multi-tenant SaaS feature with Entra ID authentication, React admin UI, Node API, tenant-isolated SQL schema migration and backfill, Azure infrastructure, managed identity and secrets, security review, load tests, staged deployment, rollback rehearsal, documentation, and production approval.

estimate.evidence: Cross-team workshops to define tenant isolation model, compliance, and SLAs

tasks.title: Solution architecture and API contract design

estimate.evidence: Define service boundaries, auth flows, and OpenAPI contracts
Row-level security vs schema-per-tenant tradeoff, indexing
STRIDE analysis for multi-tenant boundaries and Entra ID
Bicep for App Service, Azure SQL, VNet, Key Vault

tasks.title: Managed identity and Key Vault secrets configuration
Entra ID authentication and authorization integration

estimate.evidence: OIDC, multi-tenant app registration, token validation

tasks.title: Node API implementation with tenant scoping

estimate.evidence: REST endpoints, per-tenant data access enforcement
Admin dashboards, MSAL sign-in, tenant management screens
Idempotent, transactional migration with tenant partitioning
Batched backfill with row counts and integrity checks
k6 scenarios against staging, per-tenant throughput targets
Tenant isolation verification, auth bypass and OWASP checks
API docs, onboarding guide, incident and rollback runbooks
Blue-green/canary rollout with gated health checks
Validate rollback of code and reversible data migration
Sign-off gate requiring security, load, docs, and rollback evidence
